name: AverageStrategy EMA8/21 cross (4h)
author: berlinguyinca collection (author not stated in file)
indicators: EMA(8) short, EMA(21) long (hyperopt ranges 5-20/20-120, defaults 8/21)
entry_long: EMA8 crosses above EMA21 AND volume>0
exit: EMA21 crosses above EMA8 AND volume>0
implementation_notes: Plain MA cross; ReinforcedAverageStrategy adds a higher-TF SMA50 filter. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
